name: e-Skoch pending orders
summary: This EA places pending buy stop and sell stop orders at a calculated distance from the current price, aiming to capture breakout moves. It uses the Stochastic oscillator as its primary signal filter to determine direction bias before placing pending orders. Orders are managed with stop loss and take profit levels, and the EA re-evaluates on each new bar to adjust or replace pending orders.
summary_zh: 该EA在当前价格的一定距离处放置挂单（买入止损和卖出止损），旨在捕捉突破行情。它使用随机指标（Stochastic）作为主要信号过滤器来判断方向偏好，然后放置相应的挂单。订单设有止损和止盈水平，EA在每个新K线时重新评估以调整或替换挂单。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于Stochastic振荡器的突破挂单交易系统。入场条件是当Stochastic指标显示超卖区域（%K上穿%D或低于阈值）时放置买入止损挂单，当显示超买区域时放置卖出止损挂单，挂单距离当前价格一定点数。出场条件包括预设的止损和止盈水平，以及挂单过期时间机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的计算方式，但未发现复杂的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，EA允许设置最大持仓数量限制以控制风险敞口。整体策略逻辑清晰，将动量指标方向判断与突破入场相结合，但缺少对市场波动率（如ATR）的自适应调整。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a pending order breakout system based on the Stochastic oscillator. Entry conditions involve placing a buy stop pending order when the Stochastic shows oversold conditions (%K crossing above %D or below a threshold) and a sell stop when overbought, with orders placed at a fixed distance from the current price. Exit conditions include predefined stop loss and take profit levels, as well as pending order expiration mechanisms. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or balance-based calculation, but there is no complex dynamic position adjustment mechanism. Money management includes a maximum open positions limit to control risk exposure. The overall strategy logic is clear, combining momentum indicator direction assessment with breakout entry, but lacks volatility-adaptive adjustments such as ATR-based distance calculation.

parameters.name: Pending_distance
parameters.description: 挂单距当前价格的点数距离
parameters.description_en: Pending order distance from current price (points)

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to identify its own orders

pros: 使用挂单方式入场，能够在突破确认后才成交，避免虚假信号导致的即时亏损
Stochastic指标提供方向过滤，减少了逆势交易的概率
设有止损止盈和最大持仓限制，风险控制框架基本完备
pros_en: Pending order entry ensures trades are only filled after breakout confirmation, avoiding immediate losses from false signals
Stochastic oscillator provides directional filtering, reducing the probability of counter-trend trades
Includes stop loss, take profit, and maximum position limits, providing a basic risk control framework
cons: 挂单距离为固定点数，未根据市场波动率（ATR）动态调整，在低波动市场可能过远而在高波动市场可能过近
缺少点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能导致买入止损订单成交后即处于亏损状态
未实现新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内重复下单或频繁修改挂单增加交易成本
cons_en: Pending order distance is fixed in points without ATR-based dynamic adjustment, potentially too far in low volatility and too close in high volatility markets
Lacks spread filtering, which can cause buy stop orders to be immediately underwater in high-spread environments
No new bar check mechanism, potentially leading to repeated order placement or frequent pending order modifications increasing trading costs
improvements: 将挂单距离改为基于ATR的动态计算，使策略能够自适应不同市场波动环境
增加点差过滤和新K线检查机制，避免高点差环境下的不利成交和同K线重复操作
improvements_en: Replace fixed pending order distance with ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to different market volatility conditions
Add spread filtering and new bar check mechanisms to avoid unfavorable fills in high-spread environments and redundant operations within the same bar

risk_points: 固定挂单距离未考虑市场波动率变化，极端行情下可能导致频繁触发或长时间不触发
缺少点差过滤，在流动性较差时段成交质量无法保证
risk_points_en: Fixed pending order distance does not account for market volatility changes, potentially causing frequent triggers or long periods without triggers in extreme conditions
Lack of spread filtering means execution quality cannot be guaranteed during low-liquidity sessions
